final_lessons: On this symbolic univariate task, deep wide layer-normalized MLPs can outperform shallower Adam models even with Adagrad.
At 64 steps, SGD variants underfit this task badly compared with the 2x256 Adam baseline.
A 2x128 normalized MLP can be competitive even with low-lr momentum SGD, while narrow high-lr RMSprop may fail.
Momentum SGD can work when paired with a deeper residual model, but no-momentum SGD and tiny AdamW remain weak.
A wide 2-layer model can make low-lr RMSprop usable, but tiny AdamW still underfits even with lr 1e-3.
Deep 256-wide Adam remains the best bet, while a 1x256 high-lr AdamW model can be decent but usually worse.
Wide 4-layer Adam can be excellent even at lr 1e-4; narrow low-lr Adagrad is very poor.
Deep 256-wide Adagrad is also strong; tiny low-lr AdamW is among the worst options.
A medium residual AdamW model at lr 1e-3 beats similar-width momentum SGD, though not as strongly as wide models.
When a previously strong deep-wide candidate reappears, prefer it over narrow high-lr variants.
